{{recipe}}| [[Cookbook:Breakfast|Breakfast]]

==Ingredients==
*2 [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]]
*2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] [[Cookbook:Cottage cheese|cottage cheese]] (small curd 4% milkfat)
*1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Mexican Seasoning|Mexican seasoning]] or [[Cookbook:Chili powder|chili powder]]

==Procedure==

#Preheat a large metal or non-stick [[Cookbook:Skillet|skillet]] over medium heat.
#[[Cookbook:Whisk|Whisk]] eggs and cottage cheese together in a small bowl; place in skillet.
#Sprinkle Mexican seasoning on eggs (to taste).
#As eggs begin to cook, start folding them together, turning as needed, until done cooking.
#Serve with or on wheat toast.
